p: Speak unto the children of Israel: After the moral and judicial law he gives them the ceremonial law that nothing should be left to man's invention.
take of them: For the building and use of the tabernacle.
shittim wood: Which is thought to be a kindred of Cedar, which will not rot.
anointing oil: Ordained for the priest.
sanctuary: A place both to offer sacrifice, and to hear the law.
testimony which I shall give thee: The stone tables, the rod of Aaron and manna which were a testimony of God's presence.
mercy seat of pure gold: There God appeared mercifully to them: and this was a figure of Christ.
dishes thereof: To set the bread upon.
work shall the candlestick be made: It shall not be molten, but beaten out of the lump of gold with the hammer.
talent of pure gold shall he: This was the talent weight of the temple, and weighed 120 pounds.
